title: Estuary kite session booking terms
titleZh: 河口風箏活動預約辦法
passage:
Bracken Reach Kite Club | First flights

The riverside field has eight places per session. Six can be reserved online; two are held for callers who cannot use the booking page. Booking is free. A confirmation goes to the person who made the reservation. If you booked for two people, both places appear in one message. Forwarding that message does not split the reservation into two separate bookings.

The outdoor session goes ahead when the wind is steady enough to fly a kite. If gusts prevent safe flying, we lead an indoor demonstration of kite assembly at the same time. Every confirmed reservation is valid for the indoor demonstration, but the demonstration does not use up the outdoor booking: anyone who attends indoors can choose a replacement outdoor session when new dates open. If you would rather not attend the demonstration, reply to your confirmation before your original start time. A reply in time also preserves the right to rebook. No reply and no attendance means the booking ends.

At arrival, the instructor checks the reservation holder’s name. A companion can come on their own only if the holder has told us their name before the session. Any borrowed kite must be returned at the field gate; indoor visitors do not collect kites.
passageZh:
Bracken Reach 風箏社｜放風箏初體驗

河畔場地每場活動有八個名額。六個可在網路上預約；另兩個保留給無法使用預約頁面的來電者。預約免費。確認通知會寄給預約人。如果你預約兩個名額，兩個都會寫在同一則通知。轉寄通知不會把兩個名額拆成兩筆預約。

風況夠穩定、適合放風箏時，戶外活動照常舉辦。如果陣風讓放風箏不安全，我們會在同一時間改辦室內風箏組裝示範。所有已確認的預約都適用於室內示範；而參加室內示範不會用掉戶外預約。參加室內場的人，在新日期開放後可以改約一場戶外活動。如果你不想參加示範，請在原訂開始時間前回覆確認通知。及時回覆也能保留改約資格。若既不回覆也不到場，該筆預約便失效。

抵達時，教練會核對預約人姓名。同行者若要單獨到場，預約人必須事先告知我們該同行者的姓名。借用的風箏須在戶外場地的入口處歸還；室內場參加者不領取風箏。
